name: Bintulu Marathon 2026
short_description: Bintulu Marathon 2026 is a full marathon, half marathon, 10km and 6km event held on 2 August 2026 in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: Bintulu Marathon 2026 took place on 2 August 2026 in Bintulu, Sarawak, Malaysia, starting and finishing at the old Bintulu airport site on Jalan Tun Ahmad Zaidi. Run by the Bintulu Development Authority (BDA) with the Bintulu Resident's Office and Bintulu Port Holdings, it offered a 42.195km full marathon, a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km competitive run and a 6km fun run.

core_facts.venue: Old Bintulu Airport site, Jalan Tun Ahmad Zaidi

pros: Marathon and half-marathon courses certified by World Athletics through AIMS
Water at almost every 2.5 km on the marathon
Crosses the new Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge
cons: Hillier than it looks: 235 m of climbing, two climbs to about 55 m before 16 km
Humid, stormy night: dew point 25°C and thunderstorms reported from 4am in 2026
Race-pack collection ran long on its busiest day in 2026

excerpt_quotes.quote: It offered breathtaking views of Sungai Kuala Kemena and the town, creating a memorable experience, especially for international runners
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Bintulu Development Authority GM Muhamad Yakup Kari, quoted in Borneo Post coverage of Bintulu Marathon 2025

excerpt_quotes.quote: the event was lauded for its excellent turnout and smooth execution, it was marred by a disappointing aftermath
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Borneo Post news report on litter after Bintulu Marathon 2025

excerpt_quotes.quote: If you're not near a bin, hold onto your trash until you find one.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Local runner Morrison, quoted in Borneo Post article on post-race litter

excerpt_quotes.quote: Rasa tidak keseorangan sepanjang larian serta interaksi dengan pelari lain meningkatkan motivasi
excerpt_quotes.attribution: First-time half marathon runner's race report on Lemon8

research_highlights: The 2025/2026 route crosses the newly-built Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge, offering views of Sungai Kuala Kemena and the town, and organisers had a kompang group performing on the bridge for atmosphere.

Race categories are Full Marathon (42.195km, 1am flag-off, 7-hour cut-off), Half Marathon (21.1km), a 10km competitive run and a 6km fun run; in 2025 the half, 10km and 6km cut-offs were 4 hours, 2h15m and 1h30m.
Race Entry Pack Collection (REPC) for the 2026 edition runs 30 July–1 August 2026 at Boulevard Shopping Mall, Bintulu.
The event has grown quickly: from 3,535 participants at the 2023 inaugural edition to 5,800 in 2024, 8,951 from 21 countries in 2025 and 10,472 from 23 countries in 2026, per BDA.
For 2026, the full and half marathon routes have received AIMS/World Athletics international certification, and the event starts/finishes at the Old Bintulu Airport site.
research_watchouts: After the 2025 race, litter including used energy gel packets and disposable cups was left scattered along the roadside and bridge despite bins being provided at every water station.
Bintulu airport reported thunderstorms from 4am to 9am during the 2026 race, and BDA noted early-morning rain before the 2025 flag-off, so wet conditions are possible on race day.
The Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge section, while scenic, was described by local press as a 'challenging' part of the 2025 route.
BDA apologised for delays at race-pack collection on the busiest day before the 2026 race, caused by a technical fault in its system and traffic around the collection site.

faqs.question: When is the Bintulu Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bintulu Marathon 2026 took place on Sunday 2 August 2026, with the full marathon flagging off at 1am. It was the fourth edition, and BDA reported 10,472 runners from 23 countries. Race packs were collected at an expo at Boulevard Shopping Mall Bintulu from 30 July to 1 August.

faqs.question: Where is the Bintulu Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race starts and finishes at the old Bintulu airport site on Jalan Tun Ahmad Zaidi, Bintulu, Sarawak. The marathon route crosses the Tun Taib Mahmud Bridge and passes the BDA Iconic Building and Tanjung Batu beach, and roads around the start were closed from 1am to 10am on race day.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at the Bintulu Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bintulu Marathon 2026 offers four categories: a 42.195 km full marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km competitive run and a 6 km fun run. The full and half marathon routes were certified by World Athletics through AIMS, and the full marathon had a 7-hour cut-off.
